/* Greeter prototype */
Greeter := Object clone
Greeter name := "world"
Greeter greet := method(times,
    text := "Hello, " .. name .. "!\n"
    for(i, 1, times, text println)
    text
)
g := Greeter clone
if(g name size > 0 and true, g greet(2), nil)
